issue.title: test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_metadata_search.py fails to collect: f4b827af6 moved _zoom_agent to _ace_agents_png_snapshot_zoom_fixtures.zoom_agent
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-u6.5.2 ("Audit the remaining visual corpus and verify the
repair", epic sase-u6.5) on 2026-08-26, confirmed and routed here by that epic's land
agent. NOT caused by sase-u6: this epic's only surfaces are Artifacts pane-description
goldens, and the broken import is in the Agents-tab visual suite.

`tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_metadata_search.py` cannot be
collected at all:

```
tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_metadata_search.py:20: in <module>
    from tests.ace.tui.visual.test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_zoom import _zoom_agent
E   ImportError: cannot import name '_zoom_agent' from
    'tests.ace.tui.visual.test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_zoom'
```

ROOT CAUSE: commit f4b827af6 ("test(ace): split agents zoom PNG snapshot tests into topic
files", agent bbugyi200.athena.toobig-4f.test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_zoom.0) split the
703-line zoom module and moved the shared Agent fixture out of
`test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_zoom.py` into the new
`tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_agents_png_snapshot_zoom_fixtures.py`, renaming it from
`_zoom_agent` to the module-public `zoom_agent` (defined at
`_ace_agents_png_snapshot_zoom_fixtures.py:28`). The split updated the modules it
created but left this pre-existing sibling importing the old private name from the old
location. `grep -rn '_zoom_agent\b' tests/` returns only the two stale sites in
`test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_metadata_search.py` (lines 20 and 30); no definition of
`_zoom_agent` survives anywhere in the tree.

FIX: point line 20 at
`from tests.ace.tui.visual._ace_agents_png_snapshot_zoom_fixtures import zoom_agent`
and update the call on line 30, then run the module and confirm its
`agents_metadata_search_*` goldens still pass exactly. If they do not, attribute the
delta before accepting any golden (see sase-r5's per-node rule).

IMPACT: this is a collection ERROR, not a snapshot mismatch, so the whole module's
coverage is silently absent from every `just test-visual` run. It is also the only
collection error in the visual lane, which makes it cheap to fix and easy to lose inside
the ~356-failure standing visual backlog if it is not tracked separately.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic ImportError at module import time, not a runtime race: the symbol _zoom_agent does not exist anywhere in the tree (grep -rn '_zoom_agent\b' tests/ finds only the two stale references in this file). Reproduced on a clean master tree at 8d074c8dd with .venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -q tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_metadata_search.py, which exits with 'no tests collected, 1 error'. It cannot pass on a rerun because collection never reaches any test body.

payload.description: Both are red nodes in the just test-visual lane, but this one is a collection ERROR from a stale import left by the f4b827af6 topic-file split, not a stale golden; fix it here rather than folding it into that rebaseline backlog.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during unrelated sase-ug.3 (projected-artifact-link-edges) work on 2026-08-26 at HEAD 20aa9fd2c: just test-scoped raised the same collection ImportError for tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_metadata_search.py. Confirmed pre-existing via git stash on a clean tree.
